dataset.spatial_method: undealiased periodic Fourier pseudo-spectral differentiation on 511 unique nodes
dataset.time_method: SciPy DOP853 with rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12, and max_step=1e-3

implementation: Uses PhiJAX's configurable Flax NNX MLP with fixed periodic spatial features.
Uses Optax AdamW with exponential learning-rate decay.
Keeps an analytic-only builder for CPU CI and a separate generated reference dataset for numerical evaluation.
